text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognizing images, or making decisions. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. A more advanced area, called deep learning, uses complex neural networks inspired by the human brain to recognize patterns in vast amounts of information. You encounter AI every day: it recommends movies on streaming services, filters spam from your email, powers voice assistants like Siri, and helps navigation apps find the fastest route. While AI is becoming more powerful, it still depends on human guidance and careful design to work safely and fairly.
